provenance.author: Flight Simulator contributors
provenance.kind: original software familiarization; no aircraft procedure

required_truth: Recorded flight and engine review available
Display actual initialized state, not requested trim recipe

steps.title: Inspect the adopted start
steps.text: Read Actual state before continuing. A choice is a draft until initialization succeeds. Cold, already-running and prepared-airborne starts skip different work; none is an aircraft checklist.

steps.title: Inspect your controls
steps.text: Open Controls while paused. Confirm your configured assignments and inspect observed device status there. This briefing does not observe hardware. Release mouse look before using pointer controls.

steps.title: Orient the view and locator
steps.text: Use your bound view, recenter and map actions shown in Control help. The airfield is synthetic. The optional circuit reference is a fixed horizontal illustration, not a clearance, safe path or evaluated exercise.

steps.title: Continue explicitly
steps.text: Back returns to the ordinary paused menu. Only its explicit Resume action continues flight. These manual software steps do not detect takeoff, landing, engine success or completion.
